import django
from django.core.validators import URLValidator
from django.core.exceptions import ValidationError

# Setup Django
os.environ.setdefault('DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE', 'django.conf.global_settings')
django.setup()

def test_url_validation():
    validator = URLValidator()
    
    # These URLs should be INVALID according to RFC 1738 
    # because they contain unencoded ':' or '@' or '/' in username/password
    invalid_urls = [
        'http://foo/bar@example.com',
        'http://user:pass@example.com',
        'http://user:pass@domain.com',
        'http://user/pass@example.com',
        'http://user@pass@example.com',
    ]
    
    # These URLs should be VALID
    valid_urls = [
        'http://foo%40bar@example.com',  # properly encoded
        'http://user%3Apass@example.com',  # properly encoded
        'http://user%2Fpass@example.com',  # properly encoded
        'http://user:pass@domain.com/path',
        'http://user@example.com',
        'http://example.com',
    ]
    
    print('Testing INVALID URLs (should FAIL but currently PASS):')
    for url in invalid_urls:
        try:
            validator(url)
            print(f'  ❌ {url} - SHOULD BE INVALID but passed validation!')
        except ValidationError:
            print(f'  ✅ {url} - Correctly rejected')
    
    print('\nTesting VALID URLs (should PASS):')
    for url in valid_urls:
        try:
            validator(url)
            print(f'  ✅ {url} - Correctly accepted')
        except ValidationError:
            print(f'  ❌ {url} - SHOULD BE VALID but was rejected!')

test_url_validation()
"
